goal: Help small labs track reagent stock

idea.title: Barcode reagent ledger
idea.pitch: Scan a bottle in, scan it out; the lab sees what runs low before an experiment stalls.

lineage.title: Lab inventory
lineage.pitch: Know what is on the shelf.

brief.name: ReagentLedger
brief.oneLiner: Know your reagent stock before an experiment stalls.
brief.problem: Small labs find out a reagent ran out in the middle of an experiment.
brief.audience: Lab managers of 5-30 person academic labs
openQuestions: Which barcode formats do suppliers use?

hypotheses: A scan-in/scan-out ledger cuts stock-out incidents by half in labs under 30 people.
research.relatedWork: LIMS products cover inventory but are heavy; two open-source lab inventory tools exist without alerts.
